title: State law of conservation of energy

hook.scenario: Aapke ceiling fan ko electrical energy milti hai, aur wo ghoomne lagta hai (kinetic energy).
hook.question: Electricity fan mein ghoomne ki takat kahan se daalti hai, kya energy out of nowhere paida ho rahi hai?

mental_model.intuition: Energy Universe ka ek 'fixed budget' hai. Aap ek type ki energy ko dusri mein badal sakte ho, par naya coin banakar daal nahi sakte.
mental_model.description: Law of conservation of energy kehta hai ki energy na hi zero se banayi jaa sakti hai aur na hi completely destroy ki jaa sakti hai. Ye bas ek form se doosre form mein bhesh badal (transform) leti hai.

explanation:
Physics ke sabse fundamental aur important laws mein se ek hai Law of Conservation of Energy. Ye law strongly state karta hai ki 'Energy can neither be created nor destroyed; it can only be transformed from one form to another.' Iska matlab universe mein jitni total energy the, kal thi, aaj hai, aur humesha rahegi—bas form change ho jati hai.

Jab aap electric bulb on karte ho, toh electrical energy light aur heat energy mein transform hoti hai. Jab aap tali (clap) bajate ho, to aapke haathon ki muscular energy sound aur heat energy mein badal jati hai. Aapne kabhi dhyan diya hai ki agar hum dono haath aapas mein ragde toh wo garam kyun ho jate hain? Kyunki kinetic energy of motion is turning into thermal (heat) energy due to friction!

Ye universe ka ek aisa rule hai jise aaj tak koi tod nahi paaya hai. Kisi bhi isolated system (jahan bahar se kuch force ya energy na aaye) ki total energy humesha constant rehti hai.

key_points.title: Law of Conservation of Energy
key_points.detail: Energy can neither be created nor destroyed, only transformed from one form to another.

key_points.title: Total Energy is Constant
key_points.detail: The total energy before and after transformation remains exactly the same.

worked_example.problem: An electric heater is used to warm a room. Identify the energy transformation happening.

steps.narration: Uska main kaam room ko garam karna hai, yaani heat generate karna.

worked_example.answer: Electrical energy is converted into heat energy.

worked_example.problem: When you peddle a bicycle and then suddenly brake, the rims get hot. Explain this in terms of energy.

steps.narration: Moving bicycle ki energy kinetic hoti hai.
Brakes lagane par friction aata hai, jo kinetic energy ko kam karke usko doosre form mein badal deta hai.
Wo kinetic energy heat energy mein transform ho jati hai.

worked_example.answer: The kinetic energy of the bicycle is converted into heat energy due to friction at the brakes.

common_mistakes.title: Thinking energy is 'lost'
common_mistakes.explanation: Bohot log bolte hain 'energy waste ya lost' ho gayi (like sound of a motor). Yaad rakho energy universe se lost nahi hoti, bas ek un-useful form (jaise heat ya sound) mein chali jati hai. Total balance humesha match karega.

recall_questions.q: What is the law of conservation of energy?
recall_questions.answer: Energy can neither be created nor destroyed, only transformed.

recall_questions.q: What happens to the total energy of an isolated system during an energy transformation?
What energy transformation takes place in an electric motor?
recall_questions.answer: Electrical energy is converted into kinetic (mechanical) energy.

oa_questions.question: What are the various energy transformations that occur when you are riding a bicycle?
oa_questions.answer: Muscular energy of the rider is converted into kinetic energy of the bicycle. (Also some into heat due to friction).
oa_questions.approach: Identify the source of energy (muscles) and the end result (motion of the cycle).

oa_questions.question: An object of mass m is falling from a height h. What is the total energy at any point during the fall?
oa_questions.approach: By the law of conservation of energy, the sum of KE and PE remains constant and equal to the initial potential energy mgh.
